user.title: Set up Alexa Proactive Events
user.description: Enter your Amazon Developer LWA Security Profile credentials.

auth_smapi.title: Authorize Skill Management
auth_smapi.description:
**Before proceeding**, add this URL to your LWA Security Profile's **Allowed Return URLs** (under Web Settings):

`{callback_url}`

1. Open [this link]({auth_url}) to authorize skill management.
2. Sign in with your Amazon Developer account and approve.
3. Return here and click Submit.

setup.title: Creating Alexa skill...
setup.description: Setting up your proactive events skill via SMAPI

finish.title: Setup complete!
finish.description:
{build_warning}Your Alexa Proactive Events integration is ready.

**Important:** Go to the [Alexa Developer Console](https://developer.amazon.com/alexa/console/ask) and enable your skill, then say "Alexa, open {invocation_name}" on your device to link your account.

Use the `alexa_proactive.send` service in automations to send notifications.
